## Load packages

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(dplyr)
library(ctmm)
library(tibble)
```

## Import and clean Movebank data

```{r import}

setwd("your_working_directory")

# Import Red-tailed Hawk Project data from MoveBank
rtha <- read.csv("Red-tailed Hawk Project.csv")

# Remove unnecessary columns
rtha <- subset(rtha, select = -c(
  tag.voltage, study.name, gls.light.level, gps.satellite.count,
  acceleration.x, acceleration.y, acceleration.z, comments, visible,
  height.above.ellipsoid, import.marked.outlier, gps.activity.count,
  gsm.gsm.signal.strength, sensor.type, external.temperature,
  individual.taxon.canonical.name, algorithm.marked.outlier, height.raw,
  ground.speed, heading, height.above.msl
))

# Remove erroneous location data
rtha <- dplyr::filter(rtha, location.long < 200, location.lat < 200)

# Remove spaces from hawk names and rename ID column
rtha$individual.local.identifier <- gsub(" ", "", rtha$individual.local.identifier)
rtha <- rtha %>% rename(HawkID = individual.local.identifier)
```

## Filter by territory dates

```{r dates}
# Date_info contains each bird's arrival date at nesting grounds,
# plus 10-day and 80-day offsets defining the analysis window
date_info <- read.csv("Date_info.csv")

#Convert dates into UTC format 
date_info$Beginning    <- as.POSIXct(date_info$Beginning,    tz = "UTC", format = "%Y-%m-%d")
date_info$Plus.10.days <- as.POSIXct(date_info$Plus.10.days, tz = "UTC", format = "%Y-%m-%d")
date_info$Plus.80.days <- as.POSIXct(date_info$Plus.80.days, tz = "UTC", format = "%Y-%m-%d")
str(date_info)

# Format hawk timestamps as Date objects for comparison
rtha$date <- as.Date(rtha$timestamp, tz = "UTC")

# Merge hawk locations with date windows
merged <- merge(rtha, date_info, by.x = "Hawk.ID", by.y = "Hawk.ID")
table(merged$HawkID)

# Keep only locations within the 80 day window
filtered <- merged %>%
  dplyr::filter(date >= as.Date(Plus.10.days), date <= as.Date(Plus.80.days)) %>%
  select(-Plus.80.days, -Plus.10.days, -Beginning)

# Add year and unique bird-year ID
filtered$year     <- substr(filtered$date, 1, 4)
filtered$uniqueID <- paste(filtered$HawkID, filtered$year, sep = "_")

unique(filtered$uniqueID)
table(filtered$uniqueID)
```

## Subsample locations per day

```{r subsample}
pts <- filtered  # "pts" = points

str(pts)

# Points and days per bird before subsampling
sample_size_raw <- pts %>%
  group_by(uniqueID) %>%
  summarize(
    n.points = n(),
    n.days   = length(unique(date))
  )
print(sample_size_raw, n = Inf)

# Sample up to n_per_day locations per day per bird (without replacement).
# If a day has fewer than n_per_day points, all points are kept.
n_per_day  <- 10
output     <- pts[0, ]  # empty frame to accumulate results
unique_ids <- unique(pts$uniqueID)

for (i in seq_along(unique_ids)) {
  bird_i      <- pts[pts$uniqueID == unique_ids[i], ]
  pts_sampled <- bird_i %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    slice_sample(n = n_per_day)
  output <- rbind(output, pts_sampled)
}

write.csv(output, "output.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Verify subsampling
sample_size_new <- output %>%
  group_by(uniqueID) %>%
  summarize(
    n.points = n(),
    n.days   = length(unique(date))
  )
print(sample_size_new, n = Inf)
```

## CTMM and shapefile creation

```{r ctmm}
# CTMM requires a "timestamp" column in "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" format and a UUID column.
# If reading from file or timestamps need reformatting:
# output$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(gsub("Z$", "", output$timestamp),
#                                format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")

# Add unique UUID column
output <- output %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(UUID = row_number())

# Load previous results so each bird's estimates are added rather than overwritten
if (file.exists("frame.csv")) {
  results <- read.csv("frame.csv")
} else {
  results <- data.frame()
}

# OUF model starting parameters
m.ouf <- ctmm(sigma = 23 %#% "km^2", tau = c(6 %#% "day", 1 %#% "hour"))

# ---- Set the bird to process ----
# Change layer.name to the uniqueID you want to run.
# Note: if ctmm returns an AKDE list of length 1, re-running usually resolves it.
layer.name <- "franconia_2024"

# Filter, fit OUF model, and compute weighted AKDE
bird_tel <- dplyr::filter(output, uniqueID == layer.name)
bird_tel <- as.telemetry(bird_tel)
ouf      <- ctmm.fit(bird_tel, m.ouf)
ud       <- akde(bird_tel, ouf, weights = TRUE)

summary(ud)
# xlim/ylim are set for one bird; adjust or remove for others
plot(ud,
     col.DF   = "firebrick",
     col.grid = NA,
     level    = NA,
     main     = layer.name,
     xlim     = c(-90, 90),
     ylim     = c(-1800, 1300))

# Append CI estimates to results frame
ci_vals  <- summary(ud)[["CI"]]
hawk_row <- data.frame(Hawk = ci_vals, ID = layer.name)
results  <- rbind(results[results$ID != layer.name, , drop = FALSE], hawk_row)  # replaces any earlier run of the same bird

# Write 95% UD shapefile (delete_dsn = TRUE lets you re-run without an "already exists" error)
shp_frame <- SpatialPolygonsDataFrame.UD(ud,
                                          convex   = FALSE,
                                          level.UD = 0.95,
                                          level    = 0.95)
sf_obj <- st_as_sf(shp_frame)
st_write(sf_obj, paste0(layer.name, ".shp"), delete_dsn = TRUE)

# Save area estimates
write.csv(results, "frame.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
